senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; לוי; v. infra)attachment, whence

units: Ab. Zar. 25ᵃ (ref. to I Sam. IX, 24) what means v’heãleha (and that which is upon [or by] it)? שוק וא׳ that means the leg (with thigh) and the fat-tail. מאי והעליה וכ׳ and why is it called ‘and that which is upon it’? Because the leg is near the fat-tail (back).
Ḥull. 117ᵃ; a. fr.—כלפי א׳ (Ar. s. v. כלפי; ed. כלפי לָיָיא, Mss. לָיָא) towards the tail! i.e. just the reverse!, reverse it.
<cite ref="Pesachim 5b">Pes. 5ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 93b">Sabb. 93ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. [Rashi: <he>כלפי ליֵיא</he> where are you turning to?]
